confidence_notes: Food, coffee and draft beer follow current Colombo price-index averages. Cocktail and wine estimates are less certain and use local bar-price ranges, cross-checked against their relationship to beer. Accommodation is a holistic estimate based on the supplied comparable-city context; no live booking prices were used.
comparable_city_reasoning: Colombo is a larger commercial and tourism center than Mirissa, Galle, Nuwara Eliya and Dambulla. I estimate dorm and guesthouse prices around or somewhat above their ranges, with three-star rooms near or slightly above the comparables' upper end.
